question: How should AlphaLedger trade and stop during the organizer-defined P&L window?
assumptions: Erika is speaking from an official Alpaca organizer account in the authenticated lablab.ai Discord.
The account must be new and its competition starting balance must be set to exactly $100,000.
The final score is a raw account-equity snapshot at Friday 2026-09-04 09:30 America/New_York.
The options market has no regular-session opportunity before the Friday 09:30 cutoff.
The organizer has not yet specified how pre-open option marks or Thursday-expiry exercise, assignment, and settlement feed the raw-equity snapshot.
options: trade continuously and keep all positions open through the cutoff
trade Monday through Thursday and force every position flat before Thursday close
trade Monday through Thursday with a default Thursday flatten and a separately evidenced hold-through-cutoff override

evidence.source: authenticated lablab.ai Discord screenshot of Erika (Alpaca)
evidence.exact_visible_text: We start measuring P&L Mon Aug 31 -9:30 a.m. ET to Sep 4 9:30 am ET make sure to open a new account

evidence.source: authenticated lablab.ai Discord screenshot of Erika (Alpaca)
evidence.question_context: Will Thursday-expiry overnight cash settlement be included in the Sep 4 9:30 measurement, or is it a raw equity snapshot at that instant?

facts: final competition account must be new
Alpaca paper account ID is required for judging

decision: Run one deterministic controller against the new $100,000 paper account. Evaluate from Monday 09:30 ET, permit at most one C0 exploratory entry from 10:20 through 14:30 ET on Monday through Thursday, close within 45 minutes unless a smaller profit or loss boundary fires first, and make Thursday 15:45 ET the default forced-flat deadline. A hold-through-cutoff path remains disabled unless the organizer or a reproducible paper-account probe resolves option marking and Thursday-expiry settlement without ambiguity.
objective: Maximize expected raw-equity P&L during the frozen window while preserving account survival, reproducibility, and a judge-visible proof trail.
claim_ceiling: C1 for locally verified mechanics; C2 for organizer/platform facts; C0 for expected profit or likelihood of winning until independently observed competition results exist.
falsifiers: The account is not new, is not at $100,000, or has a pre-existing position or order at the baseline receipt.
Any live-money endpoint, unsupported option shape, stale evidence, unknown account state, or excess loss can reach submission.
The system enters before the measurement window, after its last-entry time, during a frozen event blackout, or after the stop boundary.
The final option valuation or Thursday-expiry settlement mechanics remain ambiguous and the system nevertheless holds through the default flatten boundary.
A strategy is selected because it looked best on the same sample used to report performance.

strategy_selection_evidence.result: No 5-minute route cleared the held-out promotion gate; the least-weak fallback is C0 exploratory only.
The validation candidate failed the untouched test; no hourly route was promoted.

cost_or_risk_budget: Use no paid data or model calls for the build; cap the isolated GCP competition runner at a $10 expected spend and do not touch pre-existing resources; cap modeled account drawdown at 1% because no signal route cleared its promotion gate.
stop_rule: Stop new entries immediately on the daily or total drawdown limit, stale or inconsistent evidence, account mismatch, reconciliation failure, order-state ambiguity, a second active writer, organizer-rule conflict, or 2026-09-03 15:45 ET. Cancel safely and reconcile before any further action.
